papers.title: Random Feature Expansions for Deep Gaussian Processes
papers.abstract: The composition of multiple Gaussian Processes as a Deep Gaussian Process (DGP) enables a deep probabilistic nonparametric approach to flexibly tackle complex machine learning problems with sound quantification of uncertainty. Existing inference approaches for DGP models have limited scalability and are notoriously cumbersome to construct. In this work, we introduce a novel formulation of DGPs based on random feature expansions that we train using stochastic variational inference. This yields a practical learning framework which significantly advances the state-of-the-art in inference for DGPs, and enables accurate quantification of uncertainty. We extensively showcase the scalability and performance of our proposal on several datasets with up to 8 million observations, and various DGP architectures with up to 30 hidden layers.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的深度高斯过程方法可扩展并量化不确定性，但未涉及有限元代理模型构建或生物力学设计约束处理。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, does not handle optimization constraints, and does not apply to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出可扩展的深度高斯过程推理方法，用于复杂机器学习任务的不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 利用随机特征扩展和随机变分推断构建深度高斯过程层。
summary_zh.result: 在多达800万观测值和30隐藏层的数据集上展示了可扩展性和性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准数据集上进行数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: This work addresses the scalability and inference challenges in Deep Gaussian Processes, enabling accurate uncertainty quantification for complex machine learning problems.
summary_en.method: The authors formulate DGPs using random feature expansions and train them via stochastic variational inference, creating a practical and scalable learning framework.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves state-of-the-art inference performance on datasets with up to 8 million observations and architectures with up to 30 hidden layers.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical benchmarks on multiple datasets demonstrate scalability and performance.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究选区激光熔化多孔金属的热导率，未涉及生物力学或植入物性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on thermal conductivity of porous metal for heat transfer applications, with no mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or biomedical context relevant to implant stress shielding or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 验证选区激光熔化多孔金属的热导率能否接近Hashin–Shtrikman理论上限。
summary_zh.method: 实验测量不同孔隙率SLM多孔铝的热导率，并与理论和数值模型对比。
summary_zh.result: 成功制备出热导率接近理论上限的多孔金属。
summary_zh.validation: 与Hashin–Shtrikman界限及数值模拟对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To experimentally determine whether selective laser melted porous metals can achieve effective thermal conductivity near the theoretical Hashin–Shtrikman upper bound.
summary_en.method: Fabricated porous aluminum samples with varying porosities via SLM and measured their thermal conductivity, comparing results with analytical bounds and finite element simulations.
summary_en.result: The fabricated porous metals exhibited thermal conductivity values approaching the Hashin–Shtrikman upper limit for the given porosity.
summary_en.validation: Validation against theoretical Hashin–Shtrikman bounds and numerical finite element models.

papers.title: Performance and Properties of an Additive Manufactured Coil for Inductive Heat Treatment in the MHz Range*
papers.abstract: Abstract In inductive heat treatment, the induction coil design plays an important role in the localization of heat generation. Therefore, the combination of an optimized coil geometry and frequency choice determines the workpiece properties and applicability of close-to-contour hardening for small parts or thin hardened layers. Additive manufacturing of copper alloys in the Selective Laser Melting (SLM) process offers a method to build coils with high design flexibility and precision. Conventional coil manufacturing methods are reaching their limitations due to the conflicting geometry specifications at the applied frequency range. In the present work, a characterization is presented and the performance of an SLM manufactured coil in MHz induction application of small surface hardened wires of steel is examined.
papers.venue: HTM Journal of Heat Treatment and Materials

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及增材制造铜线圈用于感应热处理，与用户的生物医学植入物、AI生物打印或FEA代理方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on SLM-manufactured copper coils for inductive heat treatment, with no link to biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing for orthopedic applications, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现小零件精密感应淬火所需的线圈几何优化
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM增材制造铜合金线圈，进行高频MHz感应热处理实验
summary_zh.result: SLM制造的线圈可满足复杂几何要求并产生浅层表面硬化层
summary_zh.validation: 通过钢线表面硬化实验验证线圈性能

summary_en.motivation: To overcome limitations of conventional coil manufacturing for close-to-contour inductive hardening of small parts at MHz frequencies.
summary_en.method: Copper alloy coils were fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM) and tested in a MHz induction heating setup for surface hardening of steel wires.
summary_en.result: SLM-fabricated coils achieved the required geometric precision and produced hardened surface layers on steel wires, demonstrating feasibility for complex coil designs.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization of coil performance was conducted through induction heating and hardness testing of treated steel wires.
